NDT Training and Certification in Bangkok — Thailand

Atlantis NDT delivers ASNT and ISO 9712 aligned NDT training in Bangkok: Level I, Level II and Level III programmes across ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant, eddy current and visual testing, plus API 510, API 570 and API 653 inspector preparation. Courses are authored and supervised by ASNT NDT Level III professionals.

The Bangkok inspection market

Bangkok and the Eastern Economic Corridor (Map Ta Phut, Rayong, Sriracha) host PTT (Petroleum Authority of Thailand), Thai Oil (TOP) Sriracha Refinery, IRPC Industrial Estate, Bangchak Petroleum, SCG Chemicals, and Esso Sriracha. The corridor is South-East Asia's largest integrated petrochemical zone after Singapore.

Certifications most in demand in Bangkok

Primary: ASNT. Secondary: ISO 9712. Also frequently requested: PCN, CSWIP.

Recommended certification pathway

Thailand follows TIS (Thai Industrial Standards) referenced to ASNT SNT-TC-1A and ISO 9712. The Department of Industrial Works (DIW) governs licensed welding inspection; CSWIP 3.1 dominates EPC welding inspection at Map Ta Phut.

Delivery formats

  • Classroom cohorts with supervised practical hours logged to SNT-TC-1A requirements.
  • On-site corporate training at your facility using your equipment and specimens.
  • Blended online theory through Atlantis LMS with in-person practical assessment.
